archetypes.name: dyn-gate-authority
archetypes.rationale: The change replaces prose-derived gate authority with persisted explicit outcomes.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect authored assessment persistence and ship routing. Verify every authored present-note path requires a vocabulary-valid persisted outcome, and that prose classification acts only as a one-way clean-claim veto. Check legacy and malformed metadata cannot become clean, unavailable coverage, or a ship decision. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
